font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<div style=\"font-size:0\"><span style=\"font-size:14px\">restored and visible</span></div>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
